summary: Frontend-only verification of (A) relocation of Label Alasan Amandemen / Rate Insentif Sales / Aturan & Template Bank into Pengaturan hub + removal of Konfigurasi PPh tab, (B) addition of search/pagination/status-tabs across many lists, (C) legacy-location cleanup (Koreksi & Amandemen, CRM Pelanggan, Rekonsiliasi Bank, PPh & Rekap). Tested as admin + sales. No crashes/blank screens — the five view redirects open successfully. Majority of search / status-tab / pager testids are present at the view-ids documented in the request. A handful of request view-ids do not resolve on the live site (either the hub route changed or they are hidden deep-link aliases) so filters/searches could not be reached by direct URL; several targeted testids are also missing in the deployed bundle (see details below).

ui_bugs.issue: The spec says 'the config redirect card (tax-config-redirect) shows under the PPh tab for admin/manager'. On admin the PPh tab is the default landing — header 'PPh & Rekap Pajak' with 2 'PPh' buttons visible — but [data-testid="tax-config-redirect"] is NOT rendered. 'Konfigurasi' sub-tab correctly removed (0 buttons), but the replacement redirect card is missing.

Spec expects a 'recon-rules-link' redirect-link where the removed Aturan Pembelajaran / Template Bank tabs used to live. Legacy tabs are correctly gone (both button counts = 0), but [data-testid="recon-rules-link"] is also absent — users have no visible pointer from Rekonsiliasi Bank to Pengaturan › Aturan & Template Bank.

On an immediate reload after other navigation, [data-testid="amd-reasons-search"] was present (1), but on a second cold visit it returned 0 while amd-reasons-pager stayed = 1. Reproducible: amd-reasons-search appears to be conditionally rendered (e.g. only when reasons list length > threshold or when the component re-mounts with data loaded). First-paint users may not see the search box.
View header + body render, but [data-testid="admin-records-search"] does NOT exist on this view (count=0). Request promised search here.
Status tabs are present (case-filter-status-* count = 6) but [data-testid="case-inbox-search"] does NOT exist (count=0). Request listed this screen as having a search box.

Direct URL does NOT render the Monitor Gerbang view — the main area is empty while sidebar is visible. [data-testid="rfid-reads-search"] is absent. The request specifically called out rfid-reads-search; either the view-id is wrong (expected id might be rfid-reads) or the Monitor Gerbang entry under rfid-hub is still unroutable (same pattern as the inspections deep-link bug from iter-156).

ui_bugs.component: Views that failed to render content on direct URL
ui_bugs.issue: Visiting ?view=leaves, overtime, sales-visits, employees, kontrabon, bank-recon (lines panel), production-wo, md-uom, design-gallery, grn, credit-overrides, roles, permission-matrix, hygiene, logistics (fleet sub-tab), fleet renders the shell but not the expected list, so none of the promised testids (leave-filter-status-*, overtime-filter-status-*, visits-status-filter-*, employee-filter-status-*, cb-filter-status-*, recon-filter-status-*, wo-status-filter-*, uom-filter-status-*, gallery-filter-status-*, grn-filter-*, overrides-search, role-builtin-search/pager, hygiene-search, fleet-search, recon-lines-search, runs-search) could be reached by URL. Needs correct deep-link mapping or published view-id list.

ui_bugs.component: Sales role gating on Pengaturan views
ui_bugs.issue: Navigating sales@ to ?view=amendment-reasons / incentive-rates / bank-recon-rules / cs-pajak does not just hide the tabs — it hard-redirects the user back to the LOGIN screen (visible 'AKSES SESUAI PERAN · Masuk sesuai peran...' body). Spec says 'these settings tabs are not visible' which is satisfied, but kicking the user out to /login is a UX regression — users with a valid session lose it when touching a forbidden deep-link. Expected behavior: show access-denied banner or redirect to a permitted landing while keeping the session.
ui_bugs.selector: page body for sales@ on these 4 URLs

action_items: cs-pajak: render <tax-config-redirect/> card inside the default PPh tab so admins/managers can jump to Pengaturan › Aturan Konfigurasi PPh.
bank-recon: render <recon-rules-link/> on the main Rekonsiliasi Bank view (where the old Aturan Pembelajaran / Template Bank tabs lived) so finance can discover the moved settings.
amendment-reasons: make amd-reasons-search render unconditionally (not gated on data length) — users typing before the list resolves currently see no search field.
md-categories / finance-cases: wire admin-records-search and case-inbox-search per spec; status tabs already work on finance-cases.

RFID Monitor Gerbang: fix deep-link so ?view=cs-rfid-gates (or whatever the canonical id is) actually renders the gate-reads list + rfid-reads-search. Same pattern as the iter-156 inspections deep-link bug — a hidden-tab alias is probably not routed to the component.

Publish/align the final list of view-ids. 15+ view-ids claimed in the request do not resolve on the live site (leaves, overtime, sales-visits, employees, kontrabon, production-wo, md-uom, design-gallery, grn, credit-overrides, roles, permission-matrix, hygiene, fleet, logistics-fleet). Either the hubTabs/navigationConfig entries point to different ids than documented, or they are nested sub-tabs that need to be reached by first navigating to the parent hub + sub-tab testid (not by direct ?view=).
Sales role: on access-denied for a settings view, show an in-app notice (or redirect to ?view=orders) instead of destroying the session and returning to /login.
critical_code_review_comments: Pengaturan hub now correctly groups the three relocated views under SISTEM/PENJUALAN/KEUANGAN/SDM/ORGANISASI headers — screenshot of ?view=scheduler shows all section labels + the three new tabs (Label Alasan Amandemen, Rate Insentif Sales, Aturan & Template Bank).
BankRulesSettingsView.jsx renders bank-rules-tab-rules + bank-rules-tab-formats correctly; both click without error.

StatusTabs implementation is used consistently on finance-cases (6 tabs), interco-transactions (9 tabs with counts), rnd-samples (6 chips), color-library (4 tabs), amendments (5 tabs w/counts), design-requests (8 chips), price-approvals (8 tabs), payment-plans (6 tabs), hr-attendance (9 tabs). Good uniformity.

Pager widget (pricelist-pager, inventory-board-pager, amd-reasons-pager) renders only when data > page size — correct per spec. costing-pager / config-health-pager / role-builtin-pager returned 0 on current dataset (allowed) but we could not confirm because those views have small test data.

Legacy tab cleanup done cleanly: 'Label Alasan' button no longer appears on ?view=amendments, 'Rate Insentif' button removed from ?view=customers, 'Aturan Pembelajaran' + 'Template Bank' removed from ?view=bank-recon, 'Konfigurasi' tab removed from ?view=cs-pajak.

BUT: three of the four replacement 'bridge' testids (recon-rules-link, tax-config-redirect, and the amd-reasons-link on amendments default tab) are either missing (recon, cs-pajak) or only lightly discoverable (amd-reasons-link exists on amendments). This is a half-done migration — users on the OLD hub have no breadcrumb to the NEW location.

Sales role is denied access to the four settings views, but access denial is implemented by invalidating the session instead of a soft redirect — likely a protected-route guard that unconditionally sends to /login on 403. Should instead keep the session and redirect to a permitted landing or show an access-denied toast.

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (settings relocation visible; most searches/status-tabs/pagers wired; 3 bridge-link bugs + 1 session-wipe on sales denial + several unroutable deep-link view-ids)

seed_data_creation: None. Read-only clicks only; no TEST_ records created.

rca of the issue: Pattern repeating from iteration 156: AppViewRouter / navigationConfig does not fully route all declared deep-link ids to their concrete components. The three bridge testids (tax-config-redirect, recon-rules-link, and the amd-reasons-link in some flows) that should sign-post users from the OLD location to the NEW settings tab are implemented only partially — recon-rules-link and tax-config-redirect appear to be referenced in the frontend source but are not rendered under the default sub-tab/landing of their host view. Suggested fix: ensure the removed-tab host view renders the bridge card at the top of its default panel (first sub-tab) rather than only under a conditional non-default sub-tab. For the sales session-wipe: inspect the protected-route HOC — when a sales role hits a non-permitted ?view, it is dispatching a full auth clear instead of a navigate() to a permitted route.
